reserves.name: Allocated LBMA Good Delivery PAMP gold (Swiss vaults)

reserveReview.rationale: Gold Token SA states that each DGLD represents one fine troy ounce of allocated LBMA-certified PAMP gold in MKS PAMP Swiss vaults. Each token or fraction is linked to numbered bars through the public mapper, supporting a single 100% allocated-gold reserve slice.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer litepaper and public bar-mapping architecture
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The mapper provides bar-level verification, but the static record does not reproduce changing individual bar weights or identifiers.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: Allocated LBMA Good Delivery PAMP gold (Swiss vaults)
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Allocated physical gold is external reserve backing rather than a tracked stablecoin dependency.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The issuer states that allocated gold ownership remains off balance sheet of Gold Token SA and MKS PAMP and is preserved in insolvency. The public litepaper does not explicitly state a rehypothecation prohibition.
